notes.title: Update : Full Controller Support + Bug Fixes + Performance!
notes.notes:
[p]🎮 [b]Full Controller Support[/b]
Our #1 requested feature is finally here![/p][list][*][p]Full support across combat, menus, UI, and interactive camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Visible button glyphs for seamless navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller remapping in both Main Menu & Gameplay.
Now you can fight, explore, and enjoy all the spicy details, fully on your controller. 💦[/p][/*][/list][p]🔧 [b]Ladder & Platforming Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed getting stuck while climbing (no more forced restarts!).[/p][/*][*][p]Stepping off ladders now works smoothly.[/p][/*][*][p]Abilities disabled while climbing to prevent glitches.
The entire system feels far smoother and more reliable.[/p][/*][/list][p]🌀 [b]Gameplay & Interaction[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed attacks/abilities triggering during interactive animations or altars.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera bugs when using teleporter.[/p][/*][/list][p]🌿 [b]Performance & Environment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Marshes optimized and now runs smoothly![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dungeon clipping issues where sky was visible behind doors/ladders.[/p][/*][/list]
